options.name: action
options.description: The text of the action to be added to a call. Can be multiline.

options.name: actionInvisibleForCaller
options.description: Whether the action is visible for the caller or not. If this option is used, O(action) must also be present.

options.name: allowDuplicate
options.description: If this setting is V(False) and a call with the O(externalNumber) is found, a new call will not be created. Only relevant when O(operation=new). Also requires the option O(externalNumber).

options.name: briefDescription
options.description: The short description of the call. Will be trucated to 80 characters when longer. Required when O(operation=new).

options.name: callId
options.description: ID of an existing call. Required when O(operation<>new).

options.name: callTypeId
options.description: The ID of type of the call. The ID can be found by the lookup plugin P(kembitnl.topdesk.call_searchlist#lookup). Mutually exclusive with O(callTypeName). Either O(callTypeId) or O(callTypeName) is required when O(operation=new).

options.name: callTypeName
options.description: The name of type of the call.  Mutually exclusive with O(callTypeId). Either O(callTypeId) or O(callTypeName) is required when O(operation=new).

options.name: callerLookupId
options.description: The ID of the caller. The ID can be found by the lookup plugin P(kembitnl.topdesk.person#lookup). Required when O(operation=new).

options.name: categoryId
options.description: The ID of the category. The ID can be found by the lookup plugin P(kembitnl.topdesk.call_searchlist#lookup). Mutually exclusive with O(categoryName). Required when O(operation=new), or when O(subcategoryId) or O(subcategoryName) is set.

options.name: categoryName
options.description: The name of the category. Mutually exclusive with O(categoryId). Required when O(operation=new), or when O(subcategoryId) or O(subcategoryName) is set.

options.name: debug
options.description: Whether to include debug information in the output.

options.name: entryTypeId
options.description: The ID of the entry type. The ID can be found by the lookup plugin P(kembitnl.topdesk.call_searchlist#lookup). Mutually exclusive with O(entryTypeName). Either O(entryTypeId) or O(entryTypeName) is required when O(operation=new).

options.name: entryTypeName
options.description: The name of the entry type. Mutually exclusive with O(entryTypeId). Either O(entryTypeId) or O(entryTypeName) is required when O(operation=new).

options.name: externalNumber
options.description: The text to add to the external number field. Required if O(allowDuplicate=True).

options.name: file
options.description: The filename of the file to upload. Required when O(operation=upload), ignored in all other cases.

options.name: filehidden
options.description: Whether the uploaded file is visible for the caller or not. Only relevant when O(operation='upload'), ignored in all other cases. If this option is present, O(file) must also be present.

options.name: impactId
options.description: The ID of the impact. The ID can be found by the lookup plugin P(kembitnl.topdesk.call_searchlist#lookup). Mutually exclusive with O(impactName). Either O(impactId) or O(impactName) is required when O(operation=new).

options.name: impactName
options.description: The name of the impact. Mutually exclusive with O(impactId). Either O(impactId) or O(impactName) is required when O(operation=new).

options.name: objectName
options.description: The name of the asset to link to. Use the P(kembitnl.topdesk.asset#lookup) lookup plugin for wildcard lookups.

options.name: operation
options.description: The operation that should be performed on the call.

options.name: operatorGroupId
options.description: The ID of the operator group to assign the call to. The ID can be found by the lookup plugin P(kembitnl.topdesk.operatorgroup#lookup). Required when O(operation=new), O(operation=escalate), or O(operation=deescalate), or when O(operatorId) is present.

options.name: operatorId
options.description: The ID of the operator. Can be an operatorgroup ID. The ID can be found by the lookup plugin P(kembitnl.topdesk.operator#lookup). Required when O(operation=new), O(operation=escalate), or O(operation=deescalate), or when O(operatorGroupId) is present.

options.name: processingStatusId
options.description: The ID of the processing status. The ID can be found by the lookup plugin P(kembitnl.topdesk.call_searchlist#lookup). Mutually exclusive with O(processingStatusName).

options.name: processingStatusName
options.description: The name of the processing status. Mutually exclusive with O(processingStatusId).

options.name: request
options.description: The full text of the request. Can be multiline. Required when O(operation=new).

options.name: status
options.description: The call tier (V(firstline) or V(secondline)). Required when O(operation=new).

options.name: subcategoryId
options.description: The ID of the subcategory. The ID can be found by the lookup plugin P(kembitnl.topdesk.call_searchlist#lookup). Mutually exclusive with O(subcategoryName). Either O(subcategoryId) or O(subcategoryName) is required when O(operation=new), or when either O(categoryId) or O(categoryName) is set.

options.name: subcategoryName
options.description: The name of the subcategory. Mutually exclusive with O(subcategoryId). Either O(subcategoryId) or O(subcategoryName) is required when O(operation=new), or when either O(categoryId) or O(categoryName) is set.

options.name: urgencyId
options.description: The ID of the urgency. The ID can be found by the lookup plugin P(kembitnl.topdesk.call_searchlist#lookup). Mutually exclusive with O(urgencyName). Either O(urgencyId) or O(urgencyName) is required when O(operation=new).

options.name: urgencyName
options.description: The name of the urgency. Mutually exclusive with O(urgencyId). Either O(urgencyId) or O(urgencyName) is required when O(operation=new).
